name: RAINJOKE
source:
A Mortifying Love Story between a Knight and a Maid.

You are "Rainbow", you want to maintain your good standing. You are "Joke", you are going to mess it up for her. 

[From [url=https://slitherbop.neocities.org/rainjoke]the official page[/url]]
translation:
一段发生在骑士与女仆之间、令人羞愤欲死的恋爱故事。

你是“彩虹”，一心想保住自己的良好声誉；你是“玩笑”，偏要把她的一切搅得一团糟。

[摘自[url=https://slitherbop.neocities.org/rainjoke]官方页面[/url]]
